## Scope

Describe the user-visible change and the affected release surface.

## Validation

- [ ] Python unit tests pass.
- [ ] C++17 example/tests pass when C++ code or the format contract changes.
- [ ] `python tools/validate_release.py` passes.
- [ ] PFB/PFC v1 compatibility is preserved, or a new format version is proposed.
- [ ] No proprietary input data or unapproved binary dependency is included.
- [ ] User-facing changes are recorded in `CHANGELOG.md`.
